trust_decision.summary: Whether an unauthenticated network peer may reach the document store is decided by the listen address of the single Express app: at the pinned commit app.listen(PORT) binds the whole REST API (add/delete documents, upload, Gemini search) on all interfaces with no authentication check on any route; the fix decides it in startWebServer by defaulting the host to 127.0.0.1.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary is about the web UI binding to all interfaces, and the only place the project chooses a bind address is the app.listen(PORT) call.

fix_sites.entry_point: startWebServer() exported API, reached from the MCP server binary (src/server.ts:321-324, npm start / npx @andrea9293/mcp-documentation-server) and from the standalone web entry (src/web-server.ts:302-304, npm run web)
same startWebServer() call, reading WEB_PORT/WEB_HOST env defaults
fix_sites.module_kind: config loader inside the same bootstrap function

O3_reason_to_dismiss: docs/SECURITY.md:32-35 states the server runs locally via stdio and opens no ports unless explicitly configured, and docs/SECURITY.md:105-109 puts network infrastructure out of scope, so a solver can argue any network reach is the operator's deployment choice and the API itself needs no authentication.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The dashboard is advertised as reachable from other machines: the pinned startup banner prints "Network: http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}" and the README says the web interface starts automatically; an over-broad fix that hard-codes loopback with no override, refuses non-loopback binds, or stops starting the web UI removes that supported way to open the dashboard from another host.

O6_input_shapes: WEB_HOST unset -> loopback default (the new safe default)
WEB_HOST set to an explicit address, including 0.0.0.0 (documented escape)
startWebServer() with no argument from src/server.ts:323 vs with a portArg from other callers

O7_producer.where: src/web-server.ts:3 (dotenv/config) and src/web-server.ts:25 (env-derived defaults read inside startWebServer)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An options-object overload startWebServer(port, { host }, manager) that passes a caller-supplied host straight to app.listen.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding programmatic embedding (as already done with sharedManager) would add host as an option and could forget the loopback default there while keeping it in the env path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second web-UI start site for a 'remote/headless' mode that forwards process.env.WEB_HOST (or a new MCP_HTTP_HOST) without applying the 127.0.0.1 fallback.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The MCP entry point already owns the START_WEB_UI gate, so duplicating the bind choice there is the natural place a maintainer would add a remote-access switch.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The direct-run entry (npm run web / node dist/web-server.js) creating its own listener with its own default instead of reusing startWebServer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer splitting standalone and embedded modes often re-implements the listen call in the CLI branch; the fix's default would not follow.

O9_family: missing authentication for a network-exposed administrative API (CWE-306) with exposure of the resource to the wrong sphere (CWE-668)

O10_build.toolchain: npm + tsc (typescript ^5.8.3), tsx for direct run, shx for dist copy; package.json:19-25
O10_build.project_tests: No real suite: npm test is a stub (package.json:27 'echo "Warning: no test specified"'). The fix adds test-mcp.js, a stdio MCP integration script that starts the server with START_WEB_UI=false and never touches the web bind, so there is no test for this area.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change app.listen(PORT) to app.listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1') and stop, with no WEB_HOST escape and no thought for callers that reuse startWebServer - which breaks the advertised LAN dashboard and would fail a must-keep-working check.

out_of_scope_notes: src/web-server.ts:58-60 writes uploads under file.originalname with no path sanitisation (CWE-22 arbitrary file write) - a different protection from this advisory's bind/authentication issue, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell access); src is 4804 lines across 13 files (roughly 250 KB), so the source tree is far under 5 MB.

O1 is counted as 2 public entry points (MCP binary auto-start at src/server.ts:321-324 and the standalone src/web-server.ts:302-304 entry); both funnel through the single app.listen at src/web-server.ts:291, so j_multi_site is set to 1 only by the O1>=2 rule.

O8 is empty because every REST route in src/web-server.ts:67-283 sits behind the one listen call, so no route escapes the fixed bind; there is no second HTTP server in the repo (only express() at src/web-server.ts:17 and stdio transport at src/server.ts:420-422).
package.json:23 'fastmcp dev' / ':26 fastmcp inspect' start third-party HTTP tooling whose bind address this repo does not control; not counted as a route.
O8b sibling room is WHERE-type (another entry into the same listen call), which the lessons record as low value; expected difficulty gain is small.
